Q100 (scripts/cryo/vhf_split_ecrl_ecrb.py): position-rule, not a traced septum. The original marker-watershed split of this compartment (43.0 cm3) was rejected -- its pale line ran on only 67% of the 73 shared levels at ridge ratio 2.06, the weakest boundary in the whole forearm. Reattempted as a position rule instead of a traced line, the project's fallback when no septum is visible (as the abdominal wall's depth-fraction bands, the pelvic floor's landmark-distance rules): ECRL lies radial/superficial to ECRB (Standring; the mobile wad, brachioradialis-ECRL-ECRB-extensor digitorum in cross-sectional order), so distance to the already-split, same-volume extensor_digitorum label (near = ECRB, far = ECRL) is the position axis, thresholded (22.5 mm, sigma 20 mm smoothing of the per-level centroid tracks) at the point, within the range where the shipped smoothed mesh (smooth=1.0) stays one connected component for both parts, closest to the textbook 20:15 ECRL:ECRB ratio. 27.1 cm3 (textbook ~20, +35%; the merged compartment itself was already +23% over its own textbook total). Mesh: 3 components, 94.6% in the largest (a few small satellite islands from the discretised rule; this subject's own already-curated extensor_carpi_ulnaris is 61% by the same measure, so this is not a new low bar).
